name: The Mouse

revision.note: Rewritten from the human-performer reading to a photoreal CGI animal.

rendering.limits: Mouse anatomy throughout; speaks with naturalistic muzzle and whisker movement. No clothing, no cartoon face.

gender_note.quote: cried the Mouse, who was trembling down to the end of his tail

base_age_note.reason: Persona age (a dry, pedantic elder, 'a person of authority', ch003-p03), kept for voice casting. As an animal: an old mouse with thinning fur at the muzzle and a slightly grizzled face.

hair.color: mouse grey-brown on the back, paler grey belly, grizzled at the muzzle
hair.style: short and fine; bristles up all over when he is offended; soaked flat, spiky and dripping after the pool
hair.quote: this time the Mouse was bristling all over / the animals with their fur clinging close to them
hair.reason: Bristling and wet fur are sourced; grey-brown is the natural house-mouse colour.

eyes.shape: small, bright, beady; seems to wink
eyes.quote: seemed to her to wink with one of its little eyes
eyes.reason: Little eyes are sourced; black is natural for the species.

skin.tone: pink nose, ears and feet; the thin ears go pale when he is in a passion
skin.quote: its face was quite pale (with passion, Alice thought)
skin.reason: Pallor is sourced; on a mouse it is carried by the ear and nose skin going pale and the ears flattening.

face.shape: narrow pointed mouse muzzle, large thin round ears
features: long fine whiskers that twitch when he lectures
face.default_expression: prickly, easily offended, lecturing; sits up stiffly to recite
face.expressiveness: ear angle, whisker tension, bristled fur and a stiff sit-up posture; no human facial expressions
face.reason: Not described; manner follows ch003-p40 'you’re so easily offended'.

build.height_note: Sitting-up height. Body 8-9 cm; tail about as long again.
build.posture: sits up on his haunches to address the party; swims with his head held high
build.scale_reference: Natural mouse size. In the pool and on the bank Alice is shrunk (SUP-003) and the Mouse is still small next to her: about the size of her forearm. He sits in the middle of the circle, the party gathered round.
build.reason: Species-true size; relative scale follows the shrunken Alice of ch002-ch003.

marks.description: a long, thin, scaly, pink-grey mouse tail, which Alice looks down at in wonder (the tale/tail pun)
marks.quote: “It _is_ a long tail, certainly,” said Alice, looking down with wonder at the Mouse’s tail

marks.description: soaking wet from swimming the pool of tears, drying fluffier after the race

default_outfit_tone.summary: none: he wears nothing; his look is the wet grey-brown coat
default_outfit_tone.reason: The text gives the Mouse no clothing or prop; per SUP-002 (BIB-0027) only text-given props are worn, so the old tailcoat is dropped.

sound_tic: a faint squeak or sniff under indignant lines
prompt_base_en: photoreal old grey-brown house mouse, fur soaking wet and bristling, small glossy black beady eyes, large thin round ears, long twitching whiskers, long thin pink-grey tail, sitting up stiffly on a muddy pool bank, natural mouse anatomy, no clothing, live-action film plate
